final_topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
final_topology.description: A secure hierarchical network with an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to remote sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN links to a regional and branch office with local routing and switching.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Asset Management System (n27) that manages various nodes across different zones, indicating an inventory management process.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, nl3) and zone links (e.g., zl1, zl2) that document data flows between different zones and nodes.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Sensitive Data Zone (z6) and a Non-Production Zone (z7), indicating segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes host firewalls (n14, n15) on servers in the Data Center (z2) and Sensitive Data Zone (z6).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n16) in the Internet Edge (z1) and links (nl11) to the firewall, indicating trusted DNS resolution.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server (n17) linked to the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10) via link (nl12), indicating MFA for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Filtering Appliance (n18) linked to the firewall (n1) via link (nl13), indicating DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Web Proxy (n19) linked to the firewall (n1) via link (nl14), indicating network-based URL filtering.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a hierarchical network with an Internet Edge (z1), Data Center (z2), Regional Office (z3), Branch Office (z4), and Management (z5) zones, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes IaC Management (n28) and links (nl49, nl50, nl51) to various network devices, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server (n20) linked to the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10) via link (nl15), indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10) linked to the Central AAA Server (n20) via link (nl15), indicating remote devices utilizing a VPN and connecting to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IDS/IPS (n12) and NIDS (n21) linked to the firewall (n1) via links (nl2, nl16), indicating deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple uplink links (e.g., zl1, zl2, zl3) between different zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n23) linked to the Remote Access VPN Gateway (n10) via link (nl18), indicating management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Flow Log Collector (n24) linked to the firewall (n1) via link (nl19), indicating collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Non-Production Zone (z7) and a Data Center (z2), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Pen Testing Tool (n29) linked to various nodes and zones, indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z8 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: node_link_invalid_endpoint
findings_before.missing_reason: Node link nl10 references missing endpoint(s): n15, n26.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing concrete endpoint node(s), or add a valid replacement node_link.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit inventory management system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) but does not explicitly show secure management practices such as IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices like IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and links to network devices to indicate secure management.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not include any nodes or links related to external penetration testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No evidence of external penetration testing tools or processes.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an external penetration testing tool and links to relevant network zones to indicate periodic testing.
